items.name: Broken Sword

items.name: Ancient Amulet
items.description: You were asked to retrieve this. Don't lose it.

items.name: Bounty Gold
items.description: The bounty paid out after the bandit king is dealt with.

items.name: Evidence Letter
items.description: Proof of the bandit king's crimes. Hand it in to the sheriff.
